releaseNotes:
v4.1.0: Ultra performance + UX upgrade pass.

🎬 PLAYER ENHANCEMENTS:
• MENU key cycles aspect ratio (Auto → 16:9 → 4:3 → 1:1 → Fill) with OSD indicator
• MENU key (2nd press) shows stream info overlay: codec, resolution, audio channels, bitrate
• UP/DOWN keys now control volume in VOD/DVR mode (10% steps, 0–200% range)
• Auto-deinterlace enabled for all live streams (yadif2x — best quality for sports/broadcast)
• Live streams no longer drop frames to catch up — prevents audio desync on busy channels

📺 LIVE TV GUIDE IMPROVEMENTS:
• Channel rows now show EPG progress bar (how far through the current program)
• 'Up Next' label shows the next program title when a channel row is focused
• Channel logos smoothly scale up when focused (44→48dp animated)

🎥 MOVIES & SERIES:
• Movie and Series poster cards show a heart icon when focused (add-to-favorites affordance)
• Movie detail screen: similar titles rail uses fast tween animation (no more spring jank on Firestick)
• Action button animations converted to smooth tween(120ms) for consistent 60fps on Fire TV

🏠 HOME SCREEN:
• Hero banner auto-scroll pauses when the Play button is focused (no more rotation mid-action)

🔍 SEARCH:
• Recent searches displayed when search bar is blank — tap to instantly re-run any previous search

⭐ FAVORITES:
• Empty state now has a 'Browse Content' button so first-time users don't get stuck

⚡ PERFORMANCE:
• Series info responses now cached (50-entry FIFO, same TTL as VOD) — faster re-visits
• Series info cache cleared on logout to prevent stale data between profiles

🔧 BUILD:
• targetSdk bumped to 35 (Android 15) — full compliance for Play Store submission
